requirements.notes: Read the 4+ years as applying to Kotlin specifically, as written. Android development experience is listed separately because Kotlin years alone do not show Android work.

shortlist.name: Priyanka Nair
shortlist.recommendation_reason: Meets every must-have, with evidence quoted from the resume.

verdicts.evidence: Built checkout and order-tracking features in Kotlin and Java; Espresso UI tests; Firebase analytics.
verdicts.reasoning: Kotlin is used in both roles: Jul 2021–Jul 2023 (2 years) plus Aug 2023–Oct 2026 (about 3.2 years) comes to about 5.2 years, which exceeds 4.
Both of her jobs are Android developer roles, which directly shows Android development experience.

shortlist.name: Sofia Novak
shortlist.recommendation_reason: Meets every must-have, with evidence quoted from the resume.

verdicts.evidence: Built offline sync for the Android app with Kotlin coroutines and Room.
verdicts.reasoning: The Kestrel Mobile role (2021 to Present, October 2026) explicitly uses Kotlin, which is about 5 years and meets the 4-year requirement; the Mosaic role does not name Kotlin.

verdicts.evidence: Built the flashcard app (more than 1 million downloads) for iOS and Android.
verdicts.reasoning: Both jobs include shipping Android apps, at Kestrel Mobile and at Mosaic Learning.

shortlist.name: Lukas Becker
shortlist.recommendation_reason: Meets every must-have, with evidence quoted from the resume.

verdicts.evidence: the Android app in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose from a shared GraphQL API

The candidate held an Android Developer role and currently ships the Android app at Pulsewave Health.

verdicts.evidence: Built the Android app used by 120k monthly active users, rated 4.8 in the store.
verdicts.reasoning: Both roles describe hands-on Android work, from Sep 2020 to the present.
